_doc: Elemental Gates. Built from compact specs; see CLAUDE.md > Gates.

gates.name: the Rootdeep Caverns
gates.description: A rift under an old oak near the village leads into caves where the roots of the world run like veins through living stone.
gates.entry_text: The tunnel walls are made of root and rock grown together. They creak when you touch them, like an old man stretching.

rooms.text: Small stone creatures roll out of the walls like boulders.
A cave where the roots shift and grab.

check.success: You tear free of the roots and pry loose a chip of heartstone.
check.fail: The roots tighten around your leg and squeeze.

rooms.text: Crawlers made of roots scuttle across the ceiling.

rootdeep_caverns_earth_elemental.title: the Heartstone Elemental
rootdeep_caverns_earth_elemental.intro: A figure of stone and root rises from a pool of mud, a glowing green stone at its chest. The caves shake when it steps.
rootdeep_caverns_earth_elemental.victory: The Elemental crumbles into a heap of earth, and its heartstone dims.

study.text: Its heartstone is exposed when it raises its arms.

rootdeep_caverns_mole_king.title: the Mole King
rootdeep_caverns_mole_king.intro: With the elemental gone, the moles moved in. King {name} is the size of a bear and wears a crown of gemstones.
rootdeep_caverns_mole_king.victory: King {name} burrows away, defeated, leaving his crown behind.
rootdeep_caverns_mole_king.arrival_omen: New tunnels riddle the grotto walls. Something is digging.
rootdeep_caverns_mole_king.arrival_rumour: A giant mole has claimed the Rootdeep Caverns. He's digging under the village.

study.text: He's nearly blind. Stay still and quiet.

rootdeep_caverns_crystal_heart.title: the Awakened Geode
rootdeep_caverns_crystal_heart.intro: Your magic woke the crystals in the deep stone. A great geode has split open, and what came out is all sharp edges.
rootdeep_caverns_crystal_heart.victory: The Awakened Geode shatters along its planes.
rootdeep_caverns_crystal_heart.arrival_omen: Crystals are pushing out through the grotto walls, glowing.
rootdeep_caverns_crystal_heart.arrival_rumour: The Rootdeep Caverns are growing crystals. Something sharp lives in the deep stone now.

study.text: Crystals have planes. Strike along one and it shatters.

rootdeep_caverns_world_root.title: the Root of the Old Oak
rootdeep_caverns_world_root.intro: The oak above the caves has sent its taproot down to reclaim its home. It moves through the stone like a snake through grass.
rootdeep_caverns_world_root.victory: The great root withers and goes still.
rootdeep_caverns_world_root.arrival_omen: The oak's roots have broken through the grotto ceiling, and they are moving.
rootdeep_caverns_world_root.arrival_rumour: The old oak by the village is moving its roots. The Rootdeep Caverns have a new master: the tree itself.

study.text: It's still attached to the tree. Sever it, and it withers.

gates.name: the Cinder Forge
gates.description: A rift that opened on the slopes above the village glows red at night. The System calls it a FORGE-CLASS GATE.
gates.entry_text: The heat hits you like a wall. Rivers of lava run in channels cut by someone, or something, with a purpose.

rooms.text: Salamanders bask on the rocks by the lava, then turn to look at you.
A bridge of cooling lava crosses a river of the hot stuff.

check.success: You cross quickly, and chip a lump of ember ore from the bridge.
check.fail: The bridge cracks under your boot, and the heat sears your leg.

rooms.text: Molten slag heaves itself up and shambles toward you.

cinder_forge_fire_elemental.title: Pyrrhos the Forge-Heart
cinder_forge_fire_elemental.intro: A figure of living flame works a great anvil at the center of the crucible. Pyrrhos turns. 'Metal,' it says, looking at your gear. 'Good metal.'
cinder_forge_fire_elemental.victory: Pyrrhos sputters out, and the anvil cools.

study.text: It draws heat from the lava. Fight it away from the channels.

aftermath.label: Leave the forge burning.
aftermath.text: The lava still flows. The forge will make something new.

aftermath.label: Quench the forge with the cooling pools.
aftermath.text: Steam explodes upward. The lava hardens. The crucible goes dark.

cinder_forge_forged_one.title: the Forged Champion
cinder_forge_forged_one.intro: The forge made something new. The Forged Champion is a knight of glowing steel, and its armour is still hot from the anvil.
cinder_forge_forged_one.victory: The Champion falls and its armour cracks as it cools.
cinder_forge_forged_one.arrival_omen: The anvil rings by itself. Something is being forged in the crucible.
cinder_forge_forged_one.arrival_rumour: The Cinder Forge has made itself a champion. Its armour glows red.

study.text: Freshly forged metal is brittle. Hit it hard while it cools.

cinder_forge_smith_dwarves.title: Clan {name}
cinder_forge_smith_dwarves.intro: With the forge cooled, a clan of dwarves have moved in to work its ore. Forgemaster {name} doesn't want competition.
cinder_forge_smith_dwarves.victory: Forgemaster {name} yields, grumbling, and the clan agrees to share the mountain.
cinder_forge_smith_dwarves.arrival_omen: Dwarven runes have been carved over the crucible door. Hammers ring in the dark.
cinder_forge_smith_dwarves.arrival_rumour: Dwarves have claimed the Cinder Forge. They sell good steel and don't like visitors.

study.text: The clan respects strength. Strike the Forgemaster first.

cinder_forge_magma_wyrm.title: the Magma Wyrm
cinder_forge_magma_wyrm.intro: Something came up through the lava channels: a great serpent of rock and fire. It coils around the anvil.
cinder_forge_magma_wyrm.victory: The Magma Wyrm sinks back into the lava and does not rise.
cinder_forge_magma_wyrm.arrival_omen: The lava channels are bubbling and rising. Something large is moving under them.
cinder_forge_magma_wyrm.arrival_rumour: A wyrm has come up through the Cinder Forge. The slopes above the village are hot to the touch.

study.text: It must surface to breathe. Strike when it surfaces.

gates.name: the Tidecall Grotto
gates.description: A rift on the lakeshore by the camp opens onto a sea cave, though there is no sea for a hundred miles. The tide comes in twice a day.
gates.entry_text: Salt spray hits your face. Phosphorescent algae light the cave in shades of blue and green.

rooms.text: Crabs the size of shields scuttle out of the tide pools.
The tide is coming in fast through a narrow channel.

check.success: You brace against the current and grab a pearl from the channel floor.
check.fail: The tide knocks you off your feet and smashes you against the rocks.

rooms.text: Nixies laugh in the shallows, then drag at your ankles.

tidecall_grotto_water_elemental.title: Undine of the Moon Pool
tidecall_grotto_water_elemental.intro: A woman made of seawater rises from the moon pool. She is beautiful, and the water around her is rising.
tidecall_grotto_water_elemental.victory: The Undine splashes down into the pool as plain water.

study.text: The tide is her strength. Fight her when the tide is out.

tidecall_grotto_sea_hag.title: the Sea Hag
tidecall_grotto_sea_hag.intro: With the Undine gone, a sea hag has crept up from the deep water. She stinks of rotting fish and she wants your voice.
tidecall_grotto_sea_hag.victory: The Sea Hag falls back into the pool with a shriek.
tidecall_grotto_sea_hag.arrival_omen: Dead fish float in the moon pool. Seaweed has been woven into the shape of a chair.
tidecall_grotto_sea_hag.arrival_rumour: A sea hag lives in the Tidecall Grotto now. She buys voices, and pays in pearls.

study.text: Never make a bargain with her, whatever she offers.

tidecall_grotto_maelstrom.title: the Maelstrom
tidecall_grotto_maelstrom.intro: Your magic set the water spinning. The moon pool has become a whirlpool with a mind, and it is trying to drag the cave down into itself.
tidecall_grotto_maelstrom.victory: The Maelstrom slows, and stops, and is only water.
tidecall_grotto_maelstrom.arrival_omen: The moon pool is turning slowly, like water going down a drain.
tidecall_grotto_maelstrom.arrival_rumour: There's a whirlpool in the Tidecall Grotto now. It pulls at boats on the lake.

study.text: It spins clockwise. Throw something heavy the other way.

tidecall_grotto_crab_king.title: the Crab King
tidecall_grotto_crab_king.intro: A crab the size of a house has come up with the tide and claimed the moon pool. It wears an old shipwreck as a shell.
tidecall_grotto_crab_king.victory: The Crab King's shell caves in, and it scuttles back into the deep.
tidecall_grotto_crab_king.arrival_omen: Huge claw marks have scored the stone around the moon pool.
tidecall_grotto_crab_king.arrival_rumour: The Tidecall Grotto has a Crab King, wearing a shipwreck for a shell.

study.text: The shipwreck is rotten in places. Break through it.

gates.name: the Rime Tomb
gates.description: A rift in the northern hills opens into a tomb of blue ice. The kings buried in it are frozen in mid-step, and their eyes follow you.
gates.entry_text: Your breath freezes into clouds that fall to the floor as snow. The cold reaches into your bones.

rooms.text: Wights in frozen armour step out of the ice walls.
An ice slide over a crevasse, slick and steep.

check.success: You slide down on your heels and catch a shard of everfrost at the bottom.
check.fail: You slide too fast and slam into the ice at the bottom.

rooms.text: Wolves with fur of frost lope out of the dark.

rime_tomb_frost_king.title: King {name} the Frozen
rime_tomb_frost_king.intro: On a throne of blue ice sits a king in a crown of icicles. King {name} has been dead for a thousand years, and has been waiting for someone to warm him.
rime_tomb_frost_king.victory: King {name} shatters on his throne like a dropped glass.

study.text: His crown holds the cold. Knock it off.

aftermath.label: Leave the throne as it is.
aftermath.text: The cold remains. The tomb will crown another.

aftermath.label: Light a fire on the throne and thaw the tomb.
aftermath.text: The ice weeps. Water runs down the walls, and the kings in the ice begin, slowly, to rot.

rime_tomb_frost_queen.title: Queen {name} of Winter
rime_tomb_frost_queen.intro: A new ruler has taken the frozen throne. Queen {name} is colder than the king ever was, and she remembers being alive.
rime_tomb_frost_queen.victory: Queen {name} sighs, a long cold breath, and is still.
rime_tomb_frost_queen.arrival_omen: Frost flowers are blooming on the throne, in the shape of a woman's handprint.
rime_tomb_frost_queen.arrival_rumour: The Rime Tomb has a queen now. The northern hills are snowed in, even in summer.

study.text: She is lonely. Speak to her, and she hesitates.

rime_tomb_thaw_dead.title: the Thawed Dead
rime_tomb_thaw_dead.intro: The tomb has thawed, and the kings in the ice have woken up, wet and rotten and furious at being disturbed.
rime_tomb_thaw_dead.victory: The Thawed King falls in a wet heap, and the others sink back into the slush.
rime_tomb_thaw_dead.arrival_omen: Water drips everywhere in the tomb. In the slush, something is moving.
rime_tomb_thaw_dead.arrival_rumour: Someone thawed the Rime Tomb, and the dead kings are walking.

study.text: They were frozen a thousand years. Their joints are stiff.

rime_tomb_frost_giant.title: the Frost Giant
rime_tomb_frost_giant.intro: A giant made of ice and snow has squeezed into the tomb to claim the throne. Jotun can barely fit, and he is not happy about it.
rime_tomb_frost_giant.victory: Jotun topples and smashes into a pile of snow.
rime_tomb_frost_giant.arrival_omen: Enormous footprints in the ice lead to the throne. The ceiling is cracked.
rime_tomb_frost_giant.arrival_rumour: A Frost Giant has squeezed into the Rime Tomb. You can hear him complaining from the hills.

study.text: He's too big for the tomb. Bring the ceiling down on him.

gates.name: the Stormcrown Eyrie
gates.description: A rift has lifted a mountaintop into the sky above the eastern road. Lightning strikes it a hundred times a day.
gates.entry_text: Wind tears at your clothes. Below you, the clouds. Above you, the storm.

rooms.text: Harpies dive out of the clouds, screeching.
A narrow ledge, swept by gusts of wind.

check.success: You hug the cliff face and pluck a feather from a nest on the way.
check.fail: A gust tears you off the ledge, and you grab the edge just in time.

rooms.text: Sprites of living wind whip around you.

stormcrown_eyrie_thunderbird.title: the Thunderbird
stormcrown_eyrie_thunderbird.intro: A great bird of storm cloud and lightning sits on a nest of shattered rock. When it opens its beak, thunder rolls out.
stormcrown_eyrie_thunderbird.victory: The Thunderbird falls and its storm breaks into a gentle rain.

study.text: It must land to strike with lightning. Strike when it lands.

stormcrown_eyrie_harpy_queen.title: the Harpy Queen
stormcrown_eyrie_harpy_queen.intro: The harpies have claimed the nest. Queen {name} sits on the Thunderbird's eggs and has no intention of letting them hatch.
stormcrown_eyrie_harpy_queen.victory: Queen {name} shrieks and flees into the clouds.
stormcrown_eyrie_harpy_queen.arrival_omen: Harpy feathers litter the nest. The eggs have been rolled to one side.
stormcrown_eyrie_harpy_queen.arrival_rumour: Harpies have taken the Stormcrown Eyrie. They raid the eastern road.

study.text: Harpies are vain. Damage her wings and she flees.

stormcrown_eyrie_storm_lord.title: the Storm Lord
stormcrown_eyrie_storm_lord.intro: Your magic and the Thunderbird's storm have merged into something new. A lord of the storm floats above the nest, a crown of lightning on its head.
stormcrown_eyrie_storm_lord.victory: The Storm Lord dissolves into the wind.
stormcrown_eyrie_storm_lord.arrival_omen: The storm over the Eyrie has stopped moving. It hangs in place, waiting.
stormcrown_eyrie_storm_lord.arrival_rumour: Something lives in the storm over the Stormcrown Eyrie, and it is not a bird.

study.text: It is pure storm. Ground it, and it fades.

stormcrown_eyrie_fledgling.title: the Thunderbird Fledgling
stormcrown_eyrie_fledgling.intro: One of the Thunderbird's eggs hatched. The fledgling is barely grown, all wings and sparks, and furious at the world.
stormcrown_eyrie_fledgling.victory: The Fledgling flaps away, wobbling, into the clouds.
stormcrown_eyrie_fledgling.arrival_omen: Eggshell litters the nest, and static crackles from a small, angry shape in the corner.
stormcrown_eyrie_fledgling.arrival_rumour: A Thunderbird egg has hatched on the Stormcrown Eyrie. The lightning there is wild and young.

study.text: It can't fly well yet. Fight it on the ground.

gates.name: the Hollow of Unmaking
gates.description: A rift full of void, the same stuff as the Fracture's wound. The System marks it with a red border and a single word: DON'T.
gates.entry_text: The ground is a suggestion. Colours drain out of you as you walk, and come back slowly when you look at them.

rooms.text: Wisps of darkness drift towards you, drinking the light from your torch.
A stretch where the floor isn't. You must walk on faith.

check.success: You walk on, refusing to look down, and find a drop of void on the far side.
check.fail: You look down. You fall a long way before the floor remembers to exist.

rooms.text: Something unmade, half a creature and half a hole, lurches toward you.

hollow_of_unmaking_void_lord.title: the Unmaker
hollow_of_unmaking_void_lord.intro: At the center, something shaped like a man made of the gaps between stars. 'Everything ends,' it says, without a mouth. 'I simply hurry it along.'
hollow_of_unmaking_void_lord.victory: The Unmaker folds in on itself and is gone, leaving a hole in the shape of a man.

study.text: It unmakes things by looking. Don't be where it's looking.

aftermath.label: Leave the hole it left behind.
aftermath.text: The hole stays. Something on the other side is curious.

aftermath.label: Seal the hole with your own light.
aftermath.text: It takes something from you, but the hole closes, and the Hollow is a little less empty.

hollow_of_unmaking_void_spawn.title: the Void Spawn
hollow_of_unmaking_void_spawn.intro: Something came through the hole. It is made of hunger, and it has never seen light before. It loves yours.
hollow_of_unmaking_void_spawn.victory: The Void Spawn scatters into darkness.
hollow_of_unmaking_void_spawn.arrival_omen: The man-shaped hole is wider now. Something is pressing through it.
hollow_of_unmaking_void_spawn.arrival_rumour: Something came out of the Hollow of Unmaking. The System has upgraded it to S-class.

study.text: It has never seen light. Blind it with yours.

hollow_of_unmaking_remade.title: the Remade
hollow_of_unmaking_remade.intro: Your light sealed the hole, and something grew in it: a being of light and void together, made from your own sacrifice. It doesn't know if it's grateful.
hollow_of_unmaking_remade.victory: The Remade fades, and leaves behind a little light.
hollow_of_unmaking_remade.arrival_omen: A soft light glows at the center of the Hollow, flickering on and off like a breath.
hollow_of_unmaking_remade.arrival_rumour: The Hollow of Unmaking has a light in it now. Something is living in the light.

study.text: It is made of you. It knows your mind. Change your mind.

hollow_of_unmaking_nothing.title: Nothing
hollow_of_unmaking_nothing.intro: There is nothing at the center of the Hollow. Nothing is very large. Nothing has noticed you.
hollow_of_unmaking_nothing.victory: Nothing withdraws. That's all. For now.
hollow_of_unmaking_nothing.arrival_omen: The center of the Hollow is completely empty. That's the problem.
hollow_of_unmaking_nothing.arrival_rumour: The Hollow of Unmaking is empty. The System says that's worse.

study.text: Nothing can't be fought. But you can refuse to be afraid of it.
